column1: # Lesson demand ratchet per level (#633, #655), checked by `kabar-tools demand --check` in CI.

# level<TAB>max % of listen items with only Arabic options<TAB>max % of multiple-choice items with only Arabic options<TAB>min words per listening text<TAB>% of listen items where the longest option is the answer, as last recorded<TAB>the same for multiple-choice items

# `-` is no limit (Javanese levels carry only the longest-option columns). The longest-option columns are not ceilings (#661): chance is 33% with three options, and far below it is as much a cue as far above. A level must stay inside 25-40%, or be no further from that band than the value recorded here.
# A batch that improves a level updates its line in the same PR: tighten the first three columns, and move the last two toward the band. Never loosen one or move it away from the band.
